key_insight: CMDO improves population-based optimization by storing and recalling search experiences as context–behavior–outcome memories, rather than only reusing past solutions.
engineering_relevance: This can make parameter tuning and model fitting for solar-cell/photovoltaic systems more adaptive, especially when the search landscape is complex, noisy, or multimodal.
method: Organizes experience into working, episodic, and consolidated memory.
Retrieves past cases by similarity to the current search state and uses both successful and unsuccessful outcomes.
Reconstructs candidate search steps from the current population using exploratory, directed, and local search behaviors with adaptive geometry.
evidence_signal: The paper reports evaluations on BBOB/COCO and CEC2017 benchmarks plus seven-parameter photovoltaic model fitting, with competitive performance and the lowest median error on CEC2017 F10 among the compared methods.
watch_item: Performance is problem-dependent, so gains may not generalize across all optimization tasks and the memory/retrieval design may add implementation complexity.
paper_title: CMDO: A Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization Algorithm for Adaptive Population-Based Search
